text:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm moving zeta-110b-v2 weights to s3://redwood-models/weights/zeta-110b/v2 this morning. Putting up a config PR shortly. Need a quick check on tokenizer edge cases + KV cache format for large max_ctx (targeting 524288).

mari: Thanks — what's actually changing on the storage side? Are we renaming shards or just moving path?

alex: Just moving path + a new manifest. Files are same sharded layout: weights-00000-of-00008.bin ... weights-00007-of-00008.bin and manifest.json at the path. No format changes to weights.

tj: FYI noticed the zeta lineage has a tokenizer PAD-token off-by-one when loading with legacy vocab merges. For very long prefixing that can shift KV indices. Can someone run the long-tokenizer smoke?

alex: Good call. I ran a quick local run with a stress sample and saw a few shifts for inputs that used explicit <pad> in the prompt. Repro command I used:
```
python -m tools.tokenizer_check \
  --model zeta-110b-v2 \
  --input-file tests/long_prompt_samples.txt \
  --max-len 524288 \
  --report-json out/tokenizer_zeta_v2_report.json
```
Output shows same token ids across shards for most cases, but ~0.7% of samples had a PAD-position delta.

sophia: Memory question — rough ballpark for KV cache at 524k tokens on our default node shape (8xA100/80GB equiv)? I need to decide whether to require quantization.

alex: Ballpark numbers (very rough):
- fp16 KV: ~180-240 GB total (model + kv state) depending on hidden dim packing.
- q4* quant (4-bit) KV: ~40-60 GB total.
If you only plan per-GPU memory, assume ~20-30GB per GPU with q4 on 8-GPU node. Those are conservative estimates — run the sizing tool.

ramon: We should lock kv_cache_format. For this model use `packed_v1` for both disk and runtime to avoid index mismatches (we had trouble with interleaved_v1 vs interleaved_v2 on older runtimes).
Config snippet to set in PR: 
```json
{
  "model": "zeta-110b-v2",
  "max_ctx": 524288,
  "kv_cache_format": "packed_v1",
  "shard_manifest": "s3://redwood-models/weights/zeta-110b/v2/manifest.json"
}
```

lee: Rollout plan suggestion:
1) deploy to staging dedicated pool (2 nodes) with canary traffic 1%.
2) monitor mem/oom/latency for 24h, if >1 OOM event rollback.
3) if stable, expand to 10% on dedicated.
Fallback: automatic routing policy to zeta-70b if OOM or mem high.

alex: I've opened PR https://git.internal/redwood/models/pull/1234 with the config + manifest path + a quick README about tokenizer caveat. Please review.

deploy-bot: config PR #1234 merged into staging by alex — CI: tokenizer-tests passed (5/5), sizing smoke (low-res) passed.

tj: Can we add a small regression test to CI that tokenizes these problematic prompts and asserts stable ids? I can add two samples and an expected token file.

alex: Yes — pls add under tests/ci/tokenizer_regressions/zeta_v2. I'll wire the CI job to run that on PRs.

mari: Awesome. Once CI + canary are green we can schedule Dedicated onboarding next week. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
